targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.name AS "Объект", avg(r.p_total) AS "кВт"
FROM readings r JOIN points p ON p.id = r.point
WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY p.name, p.sort ORDER BY p.sort

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.ts, $__interval), p.name AS metric, avg(r.p_total) AS value
FROM readings r JOIN points p ON p.id = r.point
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts)
GROUP BY 1, p.name ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Энергия за сутки по объектам, кВт·ч

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(d, 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "День", name, kwh FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', r.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Krasnoyarsk') AS d, p.name, p.sort,
         max(r.e_import) - min(r.e_import) AS kwh
  FROM readings r JOIN points p ON p.id = r.point
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts)
  GROUP BY 1, p.name, p.sort) x
ORDER BY d, sort

SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.sort) p.name AS "Объект", r.ts AS "Время",
  round(r.i1::numeric,1) AS "I1, А", round(r.i2::numeric,1) AS "I2, А", round(r.i3::numeric,1) AS "I3, А",
  round(r.p_total::numeric,2) AS "P, кВт", round(r.pf::numeric,2) AS "cos φ",
  round(r.e_import::numeric,1) AS "Приём, кВт·ч", round(r.e_export::numeric,1) AS "Отдача, кВт·ч"
FROM readings r JOIN points p ON p.id = r.point
WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '1 day'
ORDER BY p.sort, r.ts DESC
